confirmation_translation_grid: same 101 uniform float32 points plus exact nominal and nominal +/-0.05,0.10,0.20; two-step true-SOFA fork
censor_handling: one-interval terminal/truncated forks have no R2 label and are excluded from R2/delta/boundary denominators, with counts reported; never redefine F1 as R2
parent_replay: one reused scene through 108000-108029; repeat fresh ordered replay for selected-state forks after passive selection
state_selection: two per episode after a passive first replay: among decisions d>=2 with E1 history, early=min by (abs(d/(T-1)-0.25),d); high=max prior executed force among remaining d>=2, tie lower d; exactly two when T>=4; no candidate force/repair success labels used
